messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a tight one-pager + two launch posts + a webinar blurb for enterprise deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Must call out security controls and SLAs. Audience: field teams + inbound. Who owns what?
aj: I can draft the one-pager and the launch copy. Need latency/SLA bullets from eng to avoid claims that are too broad.
tom: Field requests a compact comparison row: risk profile, latency SLA tier, and cost profile. Also a single-line 'recommended use case' per mode.
kevin: I'll line up two LinkedIn posts and a short blog blurb. Need a one-sentence quote from eng on availability/latency numbers (e.g., "99.9% uptime, p95 latency X") — don't want to oversell.
lisa: looping in eng-runtime — p95/p99 exist per model+seq length. I'll pull a short 'guardrails' list and give a clear footnote about variability. ETA EOD.
aj: For the benchmark narrative, can we validate: "50k tokens/day chat workload => ~30% cost reduction using auto-batching + KV caching"? Need numbers to cite in the one-pager.
maria: CTA debate: 'Talk to Sales' vs 'Start Free Trial' — for enterprise-use content, recommend leaning sales-first, but also include trial for smaller teams. @tom your call for field.
tom: Field prefers CTA = "Request a Dedicated Eval" with a direct intake link. Keeps sales loop and qualifies capacity requests.
webinar-bot: Reminder: Webinar "Deploy Modes for Regulated Customers" scheduled Thu 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Registration: https://forms.redwood/enterprise-deploy-webinar
maria: We should include one slide on graceful degradation: model-fallbacks, region routing, and dedicated-capacity failover, plus a one-sentence incident response note.
aj: Proposed one-pager sections: 1) TL;DR 2) Deploy modes at-a-glance 3) Security & compliance 4) SLA summary (table) 5) Benchmark highlights 6) Field playbook + CTAs 7) FAQ + webinar link.
kevin: Draft intro copy: "Ship reliable, low-latency LLM features across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — with enterprise-grade SLAs and security controls." Thoughts?
lisa: Small tweak: avoid promising p99 across "all" models. Suggest: "Enterprise SLAs with clear latency tiers" + a footnote: "latency varies by model, seq len, and workload." Also attaching a minimal autoscale snippet for the Dedicated ops quick sheet: ```autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 32
  target_utilization: 0.7```
aj: Love the structure. For benchmark copyline: "Typical chat workload (50k tokens/day) — up to 30% unit-cost reduction with batching & KV caching." @lisa please confirm the "up to 30%" phrasing.
kevin: I'll draft two post variants: 1) product-led short post w/ metric callout and webinar CTA 2) enterprise exec-level post summarizing SLAs and compliance. Queue after numbers confirmed.
tom: I'll also prepare a one-paragraph field FAQ describing intake steps for Dedicated evals and the expected timeline (SLA trial, data handling, security review).
lisa: Uploaded benchmark CSV and short notes: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/enterprise_digest.csv — contains p95/p99 samples by model and seq-len.
maria: Can we have a final draft for review tomorrow 10:00am PT? @aj @kevin @lisa please confirm.
aj: Ack — will have draft by 09:30.
tom: I'll prep intake form and field FAQ by EOD.
webinar-bot: Registered attendees: 12 (auto-update hourly).
